items.title: Why Is the Sky Blue?
parts: Sunlight looks white, but it is made of many colours.
When sunlight comes into the air, the blue light bounces around the most.
So when we look up, we see blue everywhere!
Try this: look at the sky in the morning and in the evening with a grown-up. Do the colours change?

items.title: Why Do Leaves Change Colour?
parts: Why do some leaves change colour?
Leaves are green because of something called chlorophyll. It helps them make food from sunlight.
When the weather gets cooler, some trees stop making it.
Then the yellow and orange colours, hidden all along, can show!
Try this: collect leaves of different colours on a walk with a grown-up.
